title: The Friends Who Stayed
summary: In the desperate courtyard struggle, Min-Jae and Ha-Jun's former bullies risk their lives to distract Nihilux, proving the unbreakable bond of mortal human brotherhood.

panels.shot: the execution lance inches from tae-jun chestplate in frozen second
panels.action: The tip of the black obsidian spear hovers millimeters from Tae-Jun's bronze armor, lightning crackling along the shaft.

panels.shot: a high-caliber anti-materiel sniper bullet ricocheting off nihilux helm
panels.action: A heavy explosive 50-caliber round smashes into the side of Nihilux's helmet, deflecting the lance three inches off target.

panels.shot: the lance piercing through tae-jun shoulder instead of his heart
panels.action: The lance punches clean through Tae-Jun's left shoulder pauldron, missing his heart by two inches but pinning him to the ground.

panels.shot: nihilux turning his horned helm angrily toward the library roof
panels.action: Nihilux growls, glaring up at the Saint Mirren library roof where smoke drifts from a sniper barrel.

dialogue.speaker: nihilux
dialogue.text: Mortal insects dare sting an Emperor?!

panels.shot: on the library roof: min-jae holding a smoking anti-tank rifle
panels.action: Min-Jae stands on the parapet, his glasses askew, hands burned by the rifle's muzzle heat, panting heavily.

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Hey, bucket-head! Pick on someone with better aim!

panels.shot: beside min-jae: ha-jun former middle-school bullies loading magazines
panels.action: Beside Min-Jae stand Jin-Woo and Dong-Suk—the two former bullies from Episode 1—frantically reloading ammo clips.

dialogue.speaker: jin_woo
dialogue.text: Ha-Jun saved our families today! We aren't running away like cowards anymore!

panels.shot: nihilux gesturing with his off-hand firing a dark lightning bolt at the roof
panels.action: Nihilux flicks his fingers, sending a jagged bolt of black void lightning to incinerate the library roof.

panels.shot: ha-jun intercepting the lightning bolt with his bare right hand
panels.action: Ha-Jun leaps forty feet into the air, catching the black lightning in his bare palm and crushing the electricity to ash.

panels.shot: ha-jun landing before the pinned tae-jun gripping the lance shaft
panels.action: Ha-Jun lands over Tae-Jun, gripping the heavy obsidian spear shaft with both hands and wrenching it free.

panels.shot: tae-jun gasping holding his bleeding shoulder leaning against ha-jun
panels.action: Tae-Jun presses his hand to his shoulder wound, nodding weakly: 'Good save... little brother.'

panels.shot: ha-jun facing nihilux his eyes blazing with pure royal fury
panels.action: Ha-Jun's royal violet eyes blaze with unmatched intensity; the ground beneath his feet cracks for 50 yards.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: You tried to take my brother. You tried to kill my friends. You enslaved my bird.

panels.shot: ha-jun summoning the crown of the sovereign in blinding light
panels.action: The Crown of the Sovereign materializes on Ha-Jun's head, casting a golden dome of absolute dominance.

panels.shot: nihilux scoffing raising his bone whistle to his lips
panels.action: Nihilux raises the Primordial Whistle: 'Let us see if your love can survive your familiar's claws!'

dialogue.speaker: nihilux
dialogue.text: Crow! Rip out your master's eyes!!

panels.shot: the bone whistle screeching its cursed frequency across the courtyard
panels.action: The piercing whistle echoes through the air, sending shockwaves of green hypnotic miasma into Kuro's skull.

panels.shot: kuro diving like a black meteor toward ha-jun face claws bared
panels.action: Kuro dives at supersonic speed, his razor talons aiming straight for Ha-Jun's eyes.

panels.shot: ha-jun dropping his sword and opening his arms wide instead of defending
panels.action: Ha-Jun drops the Sanguine Fang onto the grass, opening both arms wide in a defenseless, loving embrace.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main tumpe kabhi hathiyar nahi uthaunga, Kuro.

panels.shot: tae-jun reaching out from the ground in panic: 'ha-jun, no!!'
panels.action: Tae-Jun shouts: 'Ha-Jun, block!! He'll tear your throat out!!'

panels.shot: kuro talons stopping one millimeter before ha-jun jugular vein
panels.action: Kuro's razor talons halt a single hair's breadth from Ha-Jun's throat, trembling violently against the air.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking into kuro green eyes with warm, unyielding brotherly love
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks into the poisonous green eyes, smiling softly: 'Kuro. Remember the rain on the rooftop.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Episode 1... Rooftop pe jab main ro raha tha... You gave me a feather. You saved my life.

panels.shot: flashback shard: kuro dropping the glowing feather onto the wet concrete
panels.action: A brief memory flashes: Kuro perched on the Saint Mirren terrace railing in the rain, leaving his feather behind.

panels.shot: ha-jun gently wrapping both warm hands around kuro small trembling body
panels.action: Ha-Jun gently cups Kuro in his hands, pulling the bird against his warm cheek without fear.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: You are not Nihilux's weapon. You are my family.

panels.shot: kuro body shuddering violently as green miasma cracks like eggshells
panels.action: The green void miasma around Kuro cracks and shatters like glass, revealing pure violet solar fire beneath.

panels.shot: kuro ruby eyes snapping back to their true brilliant crimson-violet glow
panels.action: Kuro's true eyes return—deep, noble, burning with ancient love and royal fury.

panels.shot: nihilux stumbling back in stunned disbelief: 'impossible! the primordial binding broke?!'
panels.action: Nihilux recoils, dropping the bone whistle: 'The binding of the first gods... Broken by mortal sentiment?!'

dialogue.speaker: nihilux
dialogue.text: Inconceivable! How can mortal love overpower the Void?!

panels.shot: kuro spitting out the three stolen relics into ha-jun open hands
panels.action: Kuro opens his beak, dropping the Bone, Ring, and Ashen Heart gently back into Ha-Jun's hands.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Take your keys back, My Sovereign. Let us butcher this parasite.

panels.shot: the three relics instantly re-integrating into ha-jun solar plexus
panels.action: The three relics fuse back into Ha-Jun's chest; his mana synchronization surges back to 85.0%!

panels.shot: ha-jun grabbing the fallen sanguine fang blade from the grass
panels.action: Ha-Jun picks up his blood katana; the blade blazes with twin flames of crimson blood and violet starlight.

panels.shot: kuro expanding into his full nether phoenix battle form behind ha-jun
panels.action: Kuro erupts into his 300-foot majestic Nether Phoenix form, wings framing Ha-Jun like a living throne of fire.

panels.shot: min-jae, the bullies, and the soldiers cheering from the rooftops
panels.action: Across the campus, hundreds of human students, hunters, and demons roar their battle cries in deafening unison.

panels.shot: ha-jun pointing his blazing blade directly at nihilux cliffhanger
panels.action: Ha-Jun points his sword straight into Nihilux's faceless helm: 'Nihilux. You have nowhere left to run.'
